Introduction

Fanxy Red is a Chinese girl group under TOV Entertainment. The group consists of K (Lu Keran), Roy (An Junxi), and Marco (Lin Fan).

Formed by Zhejiang Huati Culture Communication Co. Ltd. in collaboration with FFC (Fantasy Football Confederation), they debuted in 2017 as Acrush (also known as FFC-Acrush). With a lineup consisting of Min Junqian, K, Shawn (Peng Xichen), Roy, and Marco, they released their first single "Action" on April 28, 2017.

Later that year, two new members, Feng Yuxuan and Joel (Peng Yiyang) joined the group. Their second single "I'm Sorry" was released in November 2017 but did not include Min Junqian who later departed from the group in December.

In February 2018, Feng Yuxuan left and the group re-branded to Fanxy Red. In April 2019, Joel also left the group. They re-debuted in both China and South Korea with their single album "Activate" on August 28, 2019. After two years of inactivity, Shawn officially chose to leave the group in early 2022. While the group is currently on hiatus, the CEO of TOV Entertainment teased a possible 2025 comeback for the group.
